# Demant is a global hearing healthcare and audio technology group

In every aspect, from providing hearing care and delivering hearing aids to diagnostic equipment and
services to hearing care professionals and users all over the world, the Demant Group is active and
engaged.
* [ha-president-2026]
  
  ## Expansion of Demant’s Executive Leadership Team  
  
  Effective 1 June 2026, Bassel Rifai will join Demant as President of the Hearing Aids business
  area. As part of this change, Søren Nielsen will step out of his role as President of Hearing Aids
  to focus fully on his position as President & CEO of the Demant Group. Read more [here][34]
* [playsi-q1-2026]
  
  ## Interim Management Statement Q1 2026
  
  On 5 May, Demant released its [Interim Management Statement][35] for the first quarter of 2026.
  The Group delivered 6% organic revenue growth, driven by very strong organic growth of 9% in
  Hearing Aids fuelled by the leading AI-based hearing aids Oticon Zeal. You will find a link to
  the [recorded webcast][36] and the [presentation][37] here.
* [image-spot_oticon-medical-divestment]
  
  ## Demant completes divestment of Oticon Medical
  
  Demant has today completed the divestment of Oticon Medical to Impilo. The divestment allows us to
  further strengthen our commitment to delivering on our strategy by focusing on innovative
  diagnostic solutions, hearing aids technology and delivering professional, personalised care
  through our clinic network. [Read announcement][38]
* [oticon-zeal-launch]
  
  ## Oticon announces new hearing aid style
  
  Oticon Zeal™, the world's most discreet, complete hearing aid and completely new in-the-ear
  hearing aid style is the world’s first solution where users don’t need to compromise between
  in-the-ear discreetness and full functionality. Read the [announcement ][39]

# Tune in to life

Tune in to life portrays life inside Demant and how our products and services enable users to tune
in to the things that matter. In a cinematic journey into our world of hearing health,  we invite
viewers into our sound studios, our labs, our hearing care clinics and into the heart of our
production and distribution – and we see how teamwork across borders and departments forms an
indispensable foundation for our daily work.

# Important Update Regarding Eargo

For over a decade, Eargo has been dedicated to democratizing access to high-quality hearing aids and
care. Today, we write with a heavy heart to share some difficult news about the future of that
journey.

Our parent company, LXE Hearing, has begun a wind-down of its US operations. This decision follows
extensive efforts to restructure the business and pursue strategic transactions to maintain support
for our customers. Unfortunately, despite these efforts, we were unable to identify a viable path
forward and have made the difficult decision to wind down the US business.

You’re our valued customer and our priority right now is to handle this transition with the
transparency and respect you deserve. Here is what this means for you moving forward:
* **Your Hearing Aids and App:** Your hearing aids will continue to provide hearing amplification
  and core functionality. At this time, the Eargo mobile application will continue operating as
  normal. We are developing a long-term transition plan for our applications and support services
  and will provide additional information before any changes occur. Please ensure that we have your
  current email address so that you receive future updates.
* **Immediate Support:** Our customer service representatives will remain available for at least the
  next two months. They are equipped to process eligible refunds, handle troubleshooting, and assist
  with active warranties. During this period our support hours remain Mon - Fri 8 am to 8 pm CT, and
  Sat 8 am to 5 pm CT. You can reach us by emailing support@eargo.com or by phoning 1-855-690-9360.
* **Warranty Services:** We will continue processing warranty claims submitted within the next two
  months. We will provide additional information regarding warranty administration after that period
  as our transition plans develop.
* **Future Support and Services:** We are evaluating available options regarding future customer
  support, application functionality, and warranty administration. We will provide additional
  information as those plans develop which we expect to be in the next 60 days. At this time, we
  cannot guarantee the availability of any future support services beyond what is described in this
  notice.

We are incredibly grateful for the trust you placed in us and for your support in our mission over
the years. Thank you for your patience as our team works diligently to support you through this
transition.

Sincerely,

**The Eargo Team**

## FAQs

### App & Technology

Will the app continue working?

At this time, your mobile application will continue to operate normally to support your hearing
aids. We are currently developing a long-term transition plan for our applications and will ensure
we share additional information with you before any changes take place.

Can I still download the app?

The app is currently still available for download. However, please note that it will not be
available indefinitely. We are actively working on a long-term transition plan for our applications
and will be sure to notify you well in advance before download support stops.

Will future updates occur?

While we are working on a long-term transition plan for our software, the notice doesn't explicitly
state whether there will be any future software or firmware updates to fix bugs or maintain
compatibility with new phone operating systems.

### Support, Warranties, & Parts

Will customer support remain available?

Our customer service representatives will remain available through at least September 15th. They are
fully equipped to help you with troubleshooting, processing eligible refunds, and assisting with
active warranties. While we cannot guarantee support services beyond this two-month window, we are
actively evaluating our options and will update you as plans develop.

Will LXE continue honoring warranties?

We will continue to process warranty claims submitted through September, 15th. We are currently
developing plans for how warranties will be administered after this period and will provide you with
more information as those plans take shape.

What happens if I need replacement parts?

If you need replacement parts (such as tips, domes, or wax guards), please reach out to our customer
service team. During this transition period, our team will do our absolute best to accommodate your
requests, but service may be limited based on our available inventory and resources.

### Communication

Where can I receive future announcements?

All future updates and important information regarding our transition plans will be sent directly to
your email. Please take a moment to ensure we have your current email address on file so you don't
miss any updates. You can update your e-mail on file either through our App or by reaching out to
Customer Service.

Hearing Solutions with HearUSA

## Hearing Care Is Available With or Without Insurance.

You don't need hearing aid insurance coverage to start hearing better. HearUSA offers a **variety of
hearing solutions and flexible payment options** to help make hearing care more accessible.

During your appointment, we'll check your hearing, discuss your lifestyle needs, and recommend
solutions that fit both your hearing goals and your budget.

[
Claim my free hearing aid trial
][13]

## Why HearUSA?

[Hearing Aid Icon HearUSA]

### Experience life like the good old days. The HearUSA way.

Try on various hearing aids during your appointment and our professionals will identify the best
option for you. Begin the journey of simply excellent hearing and enjoy reconnecting with friends,
family and the world around you - **all with a brand recognized as America’s Best Retailer, three
years running**.
[
][14]
[Insurance Icon HearUSA]

### Maximize your insurance benefits. Our experts will discover and apply all the savings you're
### entitled to.

Our experts will find **every discount possible** and apply them to your purchase. We work with
100's of insurances and we will help uncover potential savings so that you make the most of your
valuable insurance benefits.



[
][15]
[Goal Icon HearUSA]

### Hear better today. Custom tailored hearing solution. Without the wait.

Skip the wait and enjoy same day hearing aid fittings. Book a **complimentary hearing screening**
and enjoy simply excellent hearing with your new hearing aids all in the same day! Take them for a
**60 day test trial** and if you do not love them simply return them for a full refund.
[
][16]

## HearUSA is completely different than any other provider.

Michelle’s journey to better hearing didn’t happen overnight. After years of living without hearing
aids, she finally found a hearing care provider she could trust at HearUSA.

provide personalized hearing care to help you hear - and live - life to its fullest.
[ [Person taking a hearing test] ][87]
1. Free hearing tests*
Start with a simple hearing test and same‑day results.
[Schedule your free test][88]
[ [Person smiling at hearing care professional] ][89]
2. Personalized care
Get guidance based on your hearing, lifestyle, and goals.
[See our approach][90]
[ [Person holding a hearing aid] ][91]
3. Hearing aid options
Explore models and technology to meet your unique needs.
[Hearing aid solutions][92]
[Person being fitted with hearing aid]
4. AfterCare Program
Lifetime support: batteries, cleanings, adjustments and repairs
[AfterCare details][93]

# Modern hearing aids for those with hearing loss

Oticon Zeal™

Meet the first hearing aid to do it all—unseen. Finally.
* Discreet design that fits comfortably and securely in your ear.
* Supports conversations using intelligent sound processing.
* Connects to your favorite devices.
* All-day power when you need it - enjoy up to 20 hours of battery life* and charge on the go.
* Get tested and fitted on the spot, then take your hearing aids home the same day.

[Book a risk-free trial][94] [Oticon Zeal™][95]
Oticon Own SI™

**Love your ears with our most discreet hearing aids to date.**
* Breakthrough AI technology trained on millions of complex sounds to provide a more natural
  representation of sound and speech.
* Stabilization features designed to detect and manage disruptive noises so you can enjoy the moment
  without interruption.
* Discreet design that is truly invisible in 9 out of 10 ears.⁶

[Book a risk-free trial][96] [Oticon Own SI™][97]
Oticon Intent™

**Oticon's next-generation hearing solution**
Live fully and intentionally with a revolutionary hearing solution made to fit seamlessly into your
life.
* Experience improved speech quality and listening comfort.
* Designed to be discreet, you can go about your daily life with confidence. 
* Stay connected all day with fast charging and fast pairing to your other devices.‡

[Book a risk-free trial][98] [Oticon Intent™][99]
Oticon Real™

**Oticon's all-new hearing solution**

At HearingLife, we want you to stay connected to all you love in life. With Oticon Real you
may experience:
* Exceptional speech clarity
* Significant reduction in listening effort
* Revolutionary innovation for managing wind and disruptive sounds

[Book a risk-free trial][100] [Oticon Real™][101]
Oticon Zircon

**Life-changing technology designed for celebration**

It’s time to start socializing and celebrating a life filled with sound. Oticon Zircon delivers 360°
speech and clear sound from all directions, even when in noisy environments, so you can focus on the
sounds you love.
* Powered by the Polaris™ platform – our most intelligent computer chip ever, offers more speed,
  precision and capacity
* Includes an extensive range of connectivity options that allows you to connect to a wide range
  of devices
* Available in your choice of rechargeable and non-rechargeable styles

[Book a risk-free trial][102] [Oticon hearing aids][103]
Oticon Jet PX™

Oticon Jet PX gives you quality sound in an easy-to-use device. And with five different colors, you
can choose the one that best matches your hair or skin:
* Sleek behind-the-ear hearing aid style
* A range of colors to choose from
* Lower-cost for those with budget limitations

[Book a risk-free trial][104] [Oticon Jet PX™][105]

HearingLife offers several ways to help you invest in your quality of life through hearing care,
including financing, insurance and more.

# Modern hearing aids for those with hearing loss

Oticon Zeal™

Meet the first hearing aid to do it all—unseen. Finally.
* Discreet design that fits comfortably and securely in your ear.
* Supports conversations using intelligent sound processing.
* Connects to your favorite devices.
* All-day power when you need it - enjoy up to 20 hours of battery life* and charge on the go.
* Get tested and fitted on the spot, then take your hearing aids home the same day.

[Book a risk-free trial][94] [Oticon Zeal™][95]
Oticon Own SI™

**Love your ears with our most discreet hearing aids to date.**
* Breakthrough AI technology trained on millions of complex sounds to provide a more natural
  representation of sound and speech.
* Stabilization features designed to detect and manage disruptive noises so you can enjoy the moment
  without interruption.
* Discreet design that is truly invisible in 9 out of 10 ears.⁶

[Book a risk-free trial][96] [Oticon Own SI™][97]
Oticon Intent™

**Oticon's next-generation hearing solution**
Live fully and intentionally with a revolutionary hearing solution made to fit seamlessly into your
life.
* Experience improved speech quality and listening comfort.
* Designed to be discreet, you can go about your daily life with confidence. 
* Stay connected all day with fast charging and fast pairing to your other devices.‡

[Book a risk-free trial][98] [Oticon Intent™][99]
Oticon Real™

**Oticon's all-new hearing solution**

At HearingLife, we want you to stay connected to all you love in life. With Oticon Real you
may experience:
* Exceptional speech clarity
* Significant reduction in listening effort
* Revolutionary innovation for managing wind and disruptive sounds

[Book a risk-free trial][100] [Oticon Real™][101]
Oticon Zircon

**Life-changing technology designed for celebration**

It’s time to start socializing and celebrating a life filled with sound. Oticon Zircon delivers 360°
speech and clear sound from all directions, even when in noisy environments, so you can focus on the
sounds you love.
* Powered by the Polaris™ platform – our most intelligent computer chip ever, offers more speed,
  precision and capacity
* Includes an extensive range of connectivity options that allows you to connect to a wide range
  of devices
* Available in your choice of rechargeable and non-rechargeable styles

[Book a risk-free trial][102] [Oticon hearing aids][103]
Oticon Jet PX™

Oticon Jet PX gives you quality sound in an easy-to-use device. And with five different colors, you
can choose the one that best matches your hair or skin:
* Sleek behind-the-ear hearing aid style
* A range of colors to choose from
* Lower-cost for those with budget limitations

[Book a risk-free trial][104] [Oticon Jet PX™][105]

### Sonova Annual Report 25/26

### World Hearing Day 2026

### Half-Year Results 2025/26

### A House of Brands

Sonova is the global leader in innovative hearing care solutions, combining technology leadership,
audiological expertise and a strong local presence to serve a growing number of people with hearing
loss in more than 100 countries. The Group was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Stäfa,
Switzerland.

As a vertically integrated company across its Wholesale, Retail and Cochlear Implants businesses,
Sonova operates through the brands [Phonak][288], [Unitron][289], AudioNova and [Advanced
Bionics][290] as well as recognized regional brands. 

In the 2025/26 financial year, the Group generated sales of CHF 3.6 billion, with a net profit of
CHF 546 million. Around 18,000 employees are working on achieving Sonova’s vision of a world where
everyone enjoys the delight of hearing.

[ Sonova Brands ][291]

### Europe’s Most Innovative Companies 2025

Sonova has been named one of Europe’s Most Innovative Companies 2025 by Fortune and Statista,
ranking # 12 out of 300. Innovation at Sonova has always been a shared effort—rooted in our culture
and purpose and shaped by the people behind it. This recognition reflects our commitment to
advancing hearing care so even more people can enjoy the delight of hearing. 

### Create sense with us

At Sonova, your work can help transform people’s lives. As a leading provider of innovative hearing
care solutions, we’re not just a company that makes products, we’re a team on a mission to help
people experience the joy of sound. Every day, we push the boundaries of audio technology so our
customers can enjoy life without limitations. 

Our talented and committed employees all over the world know they contribute to something greater
than themselves – they create sense.

### Sonova Annual Report 25/26

### World Hearing Day 2026

### Half-Year Results 2025/26

### A House of Brands

Sonova is the global leader in innovative hearing care solutions, combining technology leadership,
audiological expertise and a strong local presence to serve a growing number of people with hearing
loss in more than 100 countries. The Group was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Stäfa,
Switzerland.

As a vertically integrated company across its Wholesale, Retail and Cochlear Implants businesses,
Sonova operates through the brands [Phonak][288], [Unitron][289], AudioNova and [Advanced
Bionics][290] as well as recognized regional brands. 

In the 2025/26 financial year, the Group generated sales of CHF 3.6 billion, with a net profit of
CHF 546 million. Around 18,000 employees are working on achieving Sonova’s vision of a world where
everyone enjoys the delight of hearing.

At Sonova, your work can help transform people’s lives. As a leading provider of innovative hearing

# Compassionate Ear, Nose, Throat & Allergy Care

At Albany ENT & Allergy Services, our approach to care puts you at its center. With ENT, Audiology,
Allergy, Sinus and Speech specialists in one facility, you don't need an out-of-office referral for
comprehensive care.

Improving your quality of life is our primary goal, and we work as a team to achieve it. Experience
collaborative health care all in one place.

## Leader in hearing health care benefits

Amplifon was designed by audiologists to meet the challenges of the changing health care
marketplace. This design has grown to include contracted services, not only with managed care
organizations, but also with employers, third-party administrators, membership groups and government
agencies.

Today, Amplifon Hearing Health Care is the leading hearing health care benefits solution provider
with a national network of hearing health care professionals with locations across the U.S.,
covering more than 50 million American lives for 80+ partners. For 26 years, Amplifon has worked to
make hearing health care more accessible and affordable for members while helping our partners to
attract and retain members and contain rising health care costs.

## Check your hearing from home

Think you or a family member may have hearing loss? Our free, online hearing quiz and virtual
screening are fun and easy ways to discover whether or not you may need to get your hearing
professionally evaluated.

## About Audiology KZN

### Audiology KZN is a leading audiology clinic based in Hilton, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.

Specialising in newborn hearing screening, pediatric hearing tests, comprehensive hearing
assessments, hearing aid fittings, and tinnitus management. The clinic is dedicated to improving the
hearing health of each patient.
* Compassionate Approach
* Commitment to Excellence
* Transforming Lives Through Better Hearing

## Comprehensive Audiology Services

## Newborn Hearing Screening

Newborn hearing screening in audiology clinics detects hearing issues in infants shortly after birth
through simple tests, enabling early intervention and support for timely identification and
management of any impairments.

[mjrif-kw5zw.jpg]
[Pediatric-hearing.jpg]

## Pediatric Hearing

Pediatric hearing screening  involves tests to check children’s hearing. These screenings help
detect any hearing issues early for better support in speech and language development. 

## Hearing Aid Fittings

Our expert audiologists specialize in customizing and fitting hearing aids to suit your unique
hearing needs. We offer a wide range of advanced hearing aids from leading brands to ensure optimal
comfort and performance.

[zipwp-image-1e7e9PorPVU.jpeg]
[zipwp-image-4021779.jpeg]

## Hearing Assessments

Our hearing assessments are conducted by skilled audiologists to evaluate the extent of your hearing
loss. We use advanced testing methods to accurately diagnose your condition and develop an
appropriate treatment plan.

## Tinnitus Management

If you’re experiencing tinnitus, our experienced audiologists can help you effectively manage and
reduce the impact of this condition on your daily life. We offer a range of tinnitus management
strategies tailored to your individual needs

[tinnitus.jpg]

Moosa Meeran

Moosa Meeran

Moosa is a highly skilled audiologist dedicated to improving the hearing health of his patients.
With years of experience and a passion for helping others, he brings a compassionate approach to
every aspect of audiology care.

He specialises in newborn hearing screening, as well as pediatric and adult hearing
assessments. Moosa values personalized treatment plans and utilizes cutting-edge technology to
ensure optimal hearing outcomes for each individual.

Qualifications

### Education & Qualifications
* BSc (Hons) Audiology. University of Cape Town (2007).
* Bachelor of Social Science – Psychology. University of Natal (2002).

### Experience
* Over 15 years of clinical experience in working with hearing loss with both Adults and Children.

### Certification
* HPCSA registered.
* SAAA member.

### Ask Us Anything

Could working with AZ Hearing expand my business?
Yes, we always try to help our partners gain a bigger market share. Our Puro helped a few
distributors in the States achieve a huge breakthrough in e-commerce, allowing them to sell 5000
units a month. AZ Hearing does not just supply hearing aid products, we are ready and willing to
discuss business solutions with you.
Should I consider purchasing hearing aids from AZ Hearing?

Definitely. There are numbers of hearing aid suppliers in China, we may not be the best, but we’re
certainly trustworthy.
AZ Hearing is a professional manufacturers and factory of hearing aids, sound amplifiers and
faceplate in China, we have over 6 years of OEM/ODM experience.
As a medical device, hearing aid is closely related to the user’s health and life, and quality is
especially important. Quality is a key part enriches us with confidence. We share information and do
business with our partners openly and honestly. 

What are the modes of transport?

Hearing aids are relatively small in size, light in weight and high in added value, and express
delivery is the preferred method for most buyers, with express carriers including DHL, UPS, FedEx,
TNT and others. The shipping fee for the sample is around $35$-60$ based on global zones for your
reference.
If you have set up your own express account, we could ship with your account if you wish. 

What is the future of hearing aid industry?

Good question, thank you for asking it. Hearing aid manufacturing in China has developed rapidly in
the last decade or so. The market need for hearing aids is increasing with population ageing and
awareness of hearing care. From the demand side, hearing aids market is thriving.

Hearing aid technology is also evolving, for instance, the application of Bluetooth, apps and
rechargeability. We think hearing aids will become an increasingly important wearable device that
can assist users during daily life.

The involvement of tech companies like Bose, Nuhera & Eargo in recent years indicates that more and
more companies are bullish on hearing aid market.

We’re looking forward to more changes in hearing aids market and will continue to offer
cost-effective hearing aids for our partners. 

How do you ensure the quality of the product?

First of all, our factory follows ISO regulations and has a strict quality inspection process to
ensure quality. IQC is performed after raw materials are obtained, FQC is performed when production
is completed, and OQC is performed after packaging.

We also implement the CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) system to improve quality. If there
are any problems occur during the production, the process will be suspended and we will provide
feedback on the problem. Preventive actions will also be taken to stop similar problems happen in
the future. 

How does AZ Hearing provide maintenance services?

If you could repair locally, we can send components to you; or you can send defective hearing aids
back to China so we could repair/refurbish them. China Customs has strict requirements and
procedures for importing used electronics, but don’t worry, we are able to follow up to ensure a
smooth process. 

How to sell with our brand, and customize the product?
We have an ODM service, you can make your request and we will work on design and production. If you
want to sell with your own brand, we can offer a complete labeling solution, from hearing aid
lettering to packaging. For more info, you could visit our OEM/ODM page.
What is the difference between distribution of hearing aid and sound amplifier?

In short, hearing aids are medical devices, sound amplifiers are electronics. Whether they are sound
amplifiers or hearing aids depends on how different markets define each type. In some European
countries, if the gain exceeds 25dB could be a boundary. In other countries, hearing aids mean that
programmable while sound amplifiers can be digital but not programmable.

Most of our hearing aids use chips from industrial leading brands which will ensure the best
performance and high quality products.

[professional oem/odm servicer]

### Professional OEM/ODM Support

We have been offering our partners with professional labeling services since 2015. From the
engraving on hearing aids body to customized packaging, we are ready to provide these services.

### Claro -Revolutionary Rechargeable Hearing Aids
*  Automatic shutdown when charging
* LED indicator of charging status
* 3 listening programs,Telecoil available
* 4 Channel digital chip WDRC Multi Memories Amplifier

[ Get Claro Sample Now! ][47]

### Ask Us Anything

Could working with AZ Hearing expand my business?
Yes, we always try to help our partners gain a bigger market share. Our Puro helped a few
distributors in the States achieve a huge breakthrough in e-commerce, allowing them to sell 5000
units a month. AZ Hearing does not just supply hearing aid products, we are ready and willing to
discuss business solutions with you.
Should I consider purchasing hearing aids from AZ Hearing?

Definitely. There are numbers of hearing aid suppliers in China, we may not be the best, but we’re
certainly trustworthy.
AZ Hearing is a professional manufacturers and factory of hearing aids, sound amplifiers and
faceplate in China, we have over 6 years of OEM/ODM experience.
As a medical device, hearing aid is closely related to the user’s health and life, and quality is
especially important. Quality is a key part enriches us with confidence. We share information and do
business with our partners openly and honestly. 

What are the modes of transport?

Hearing aids are relatively small in size, light in weight and high in added value, and express
delivery is the preferred method for most buyers, with express carriers including DHL, UPS, FedEx,
TNT and others. The shipping fee for the sample is around $35$-60$ based on global zones for your
reference.
If you have set up your own express account, we could ship with your account if you wish. 

What is the future of hearing aid industry?

Good question, thank you for asking it. Hearing aid manufacturing in China has developed rapidly in
the last decade or so. The market need for hearing aids is increasing with population ageing and
awareness of hearing care. From the demand side, hearing aids market is thriving.

Hearing aid technology is also evolving, for instance, the application of Bluetooth, apps and
rechargeability. We think hearing aids will become an increasingly important wearable device that
can assist users during daily life.

The involvement of tech companies like Bose, Nuhera & Eargo in recent years indicates that more and
more companies are bullish on hearing aid market.

We’re looking forward to more changes in hearing aids market and will continue to offer
cost-effective hearing aids for our partners. 

How do you ensure the quality of the product?

First of all, our factory follows ISO regulations and has a strict quality inspection process to
ensure quality. IQC is performed after raw materials are obtained, FQC is performed when production
is completed, and OQC is performed after packaging.

We also implement the CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) system to improve quality. If there
are any problems occur during the production, the process will be suspended and we will provide
feedback on the problem. Preventive actions will also be taken to stop similar problems happen in
the future. 

How does AZ Hearing provide maintenance services?

If you could repair locally, we can send components to you; or you can send defective hearing aids
back to China so we could repair/refurbish them. China Customs has strict requirements and
procedures for importing used electronics, but don’t worry, we are able to follow up to ensure a
smooth process. 

How to sell with our brand, and customize the product?
We have an ODM service, you can make your request and we will work on design and production. If you
want to sell with your own brand, we can offer a complete labeling solution, from hearing aid
lettering to packaging. For more info, you could visit our OEM/ODM page.
What is the difference between distribution of hearing aid and sound amplifier?

In short, hearing aids are medical devices, sound amplifiers are electronics. Whether they are sound
amplifiers or hearing aids depends on how different markets define each type. In some European
countries, if the gain exceeds 25dB could be a boundary. In other countries, hearing aids mean that
programmable while sound amplifiers can be digital but not programmable.

# Welcome to Connecticut ENT Allergy & Sinus

[CT ENT Banner]

Connecticut ENT Allergy & Sinus delivers expert ear, nose, throat, and head and neck medical and
surgical care for adults and children from our Waterbury, Southbury, and Southington, CT offices.
Our board-certified doctors and specialists treat the full spectrum of ENT conditions, including
allergy and sinus conditions, ear infections, hearing and balance disorders, snoring and sleep
apnea, head, neck, and thyroid masses, speech and swallowing difficulties, and pediatric ENT
evaluation and management. We are committed to exceptional, patient-centered care where our
providers and staff work together to help you understand your condition and get on the path to
better health faster.

Learn about our **[services][40]** below or contact us at either of our Waterbury offices at (203)
578-4630 or (203) 574-3777 [**to schedule an appointment**][41]**.**

## Our ENT Services

Connecticut ENT Allergy & Sinus offers a full spectrum of ear, nose, and throat care, from allergy
treatment and hearing loss management to balloon sinuplasty, sleep apnea treatment, and head and
neck surgery. Our board-certified physicians bring expertise across both common and complex ENT
conditions for patients of all ages. Whatever you are facing, our team has the expertise and
experience to help you hear, breathe, and feel better.

## Insurers know the system. So do we.

Health-insurance denials follow patterns. So do the appeals that overturn them — and we've built a
system around both.

01

### 90 specialty-specific denial libraries

We know the coverage criteria, policy IDs, and appeal angles for each major insurer × condition
combination — from GLP-1 step-therapy to NCCN-guideline oncology denials.

⚖️
02

### Citations from the bodies insurers respect

AHA/ACC, ACR, ACOG, ADA, GOLD, NCI — the guidelines they can't dismiss as your opinion.

insurer denial template has a counter, and we apply the right one based on the exact wording of your
letter.

Common situations

## Not a drug denial? We handle these too.

The most common insurance denials aren't always about a specific medication. If you got one of
these, here's what to do.

[
🚑
ER VISIT

### "Not medically necessary" denial for your ER visit

Federal law protects emergency care under the prudent-layperson standard — judging the visit by what
you felt walking in, not by what the doctor found. Most ER denials are wrong.

][35][
🔬
PREVENTIVE

### Screening billed as diagnostic after they found something

Polyp removed during a screening colonoscopy doesn't convert it to a diagnostic procedure. ACA §2713
plus the federal FAQs require zero cost-sharing.

][36][
💸
SURPRISE BILL

### Out-of-network charge from an in-network facility

The No Surprises Act limits what out-of-network providers at in-network hospitals or for emergencies
can charge you. 4 quick questions to see if you qualify for federal IDR.

][37][
⚖️
EXTERNAL REVIEW

### Internal appeals failed — what's next

After two failed internal appeals, federal law gives most patients the right to an independent
external review by a non-insurer reviewer. We draft the request.

][38]
Questions

## Common questions

What if I don't have a PDF of my denial letter?+
No problem. Take a photo with your phone — we can read scanned or photographed letters just as well
as a clean PDF. We also read screenshots of denial emails.
[Take a photo and start →][39]
Will my doctor really sign a letter I bought online?+
Yes, when it's well-argued with clinical evidence. We write the letter in the professional format
doctors already use — your doctor will recognize it immediately. Most doctors are frustrated with
insurance denials too and appreciate the help.
[Start your appeal →][40]
Is my medical information safe?+
Yes. Everything is encrypted at rest and in transit (AES-256, TLS 1.3) and we've built our controls
to align with HIPAA standards. Your denial letter and personal information never leave our servers
and are only used to write your appeal.
[Read our security details →][41]
How long until I hear back from my insurance?+
Most insurance companies are required by law to respond within 30 days of receiving your appeal. We
track your deadline and remind you if anything is needed.
[Track your appeal →][42]
What if my appeal doesn't win?+
Appeals aren't guaranteed — but they work: KFF data shows insurers overturn roughly a third of
internal appeals, and independent external reviews overturn denials even more often. If denied, you
can usually file a second-level internal appeal or escalate to your state insurance commissioner. We
provide guidance for both.
[See your escalation options →][43]
Can you help with other drugs or denials?+
We're adding new denial types based on demand. Email hello@denialhelp.com with your denial type and
we'll let you know when we cover it.
[Email us your denial type →][44]

con el botón en la parte superior.

these, here's what to do.

[
🚑
ER VISIT

### "Not medically necessary" denial for your ER visit

Federal law protects emergency care under the prudent-layperson standard — judging the visit by what
you felt walking in, not by what the doctor found. Most ER denials are wrong.

][35][
🔬
PREVENTIVE

### Screening billed as diagnostic after they found something

Polyp removed during a screening colonoscopy doesn't convert it to a diagnostic procedure. ACA §2713
plus the federal FAQs require zero cost-sharing.

][36][
💸
SURPRISE BILL

### Out-of-network charge from an in-network facility

The No Surprises Act limits what out-of-network providers at in-network hospitals or for emergencies
can charge you. 4 quick questions to see if you qualify for federal IDR.

][37][
⚖️
EXTERNAL REVIEW

### Internal appeals failed — what's next

After two failed internal appeals, federal law gives most patients the right to an independent
external review by a non-insurer reviewer. We draft the request.

][38]
Questions

## Common questions

What if I don't have a PDF of my denial letter?+
No problem. Take a photo with your phone — we can read scanned or photographed letters just as well
as a clean PDF. We also read screenshots of denial emails.
[Take a photo and start →][39]
Will my doctor really sign a letter I bought online?+
Yes, when it's well-argued with clinical evidence. We write the letter in the professional format
doctors already use — your doctor will recognize it immediately. Most doctors are frustrated with
insurance denials too and appreciate the help.
[Start your appeal →][40]
Is my medical information safe?+
Yes. Everything is encrypted at rest and in transit (AES-256, TLS 1.3) and we've built our controls
to align with HIPAA standards. Your denial letter and personal information never leave our servers
and are only used to write your appeal.
[Read our security details →][41]
How long until I hear back from my insurance?+
Most insurance companies are required by law to respond within 30 days of receiving your appeal. We
track your deadline and remind you if anything is needed.
[Track your appeal →][42]
What if my appeal doesn't win?+
Appeals aren't guaranteed — but they work: KFF data shows insurers overturn roughly a third of
internal appeals, and independent external reviews overturn denials even more often. If denied, you
can usually file a second-level internal appeal or escalate to your state insurance commissioner. We
provide guidance for both.
[See your escalation options →][43]
Can you help with other drugs or denials?+
We're adding new denial types based on demand. Email hello@denialhelp.com with your denial type and
we'll let you know when we cover it.
[Email us your denial type →][44]

Toda la página, el formulario y la carta de apelación están disponibles en español. Cambia el idioma
con el botón en la parte superior.

# DUNGARVAN AUDIOLOGY & HEARING AID CLINIC Ltd.

Home: Welcome

## Welcome to Dungarvan Audiology, your trusted partner in comprehensive hearing care. I offer a
## wide range of services to meet all your audiology needs, from diagnostic hearing assessments to
## custom ear moulds. My goal is to ensure you receive the highest quality care.

Home: Text

## SERVICES PROVIDED

Care Tailored to You

[equipment_edited.jpg]

### EXAMINATION

Diagnostic Hearing assessments for adults and children

Pre-employment tests

Diagnostic Hearing Assessments for Adults and Children

At Dungarvan Audiology, I provide thorough diagnostic hearing assessments for both adults and
children. Using state-of-the-art equipment, I conduct a variety of tests, including pure-tone
audiometry, speech audiometry, and tympanometry. Early detection and intervention are key to
managing hearing loss effectively. Schedule your hearing assessment today to ensure optimal hearing
health for you and your family.


Pre-Employment Hearing Tests

Ensure you meet the auditory requirements for your job with my pre-employment hearing tests. I offer
comprehensive hearing screenings, including pure-tone audiometry and speech audiometry, to help you
secure your position and maintain workplace safety. Regular monitoring in compliance with OSHA
guidelines is also available to protect your hearing health in noisy environments.

### HEARING AIDS

PRSI Grants Available

Demo hearing aids available to trial


PRSI Grants Available

Take advantage of the PRSI grants available for hearing aids at Dungarvan Audiology. I will guide
you through the application process to ensure you receive the financial assistance you need.
Discover the latest in hearing aid technology and improve your quality of life with affordable
solutions.


Demo Hearing Aids Available to Trial

Experience the benefits of better hearing first hand with my demo hearing aids. At Dungarvan
Audiology, I offer a range of hearing aids available for trial, allowing you to find the perfect fit
for your lifestyle. Book your trial today and hear the difference.


Making sure that you benefit from the latest medical advances is extremely important. That is why
Dungarvan Audiology and Hearing Aid Clinic provides innovative treatments to help you live active
and productive lives. Contact the practice to schedule your next appointment.

[signia pic_edited.jpg]
[Putting on Goggles_edited.jpg]

### EAR MOULDS

Custom made for musicians, noise protection and swimming

Protect your ears with custom-made ear moulds from Dungarvan Audiology. Whether you're a musician
needing high-fidelity earplugs, require noise protection in loud environments, or need swim plugs to
prevent water from entering your ears, my custom solutions provide the perfect fit and maximum
comfort. Contact me to learn more about bespoke ear moulds.

### TINNITUS MANAGEMENT

Tailored to your individual needs



Managing tinnitus can be challenging, but at Dungarvan Audiology, I offer personalised tinnitus
management plans tailored to your specific needs. Using a combination of therapies,
including counselling, and hearing aids, I help reduce the impact of tinnitus on your daily life.
Schedule a consultation today to find relief from tinnitus.

Nothing matters to Dungarvan Audiology and Hearing Aid Clinic more than the health of you and your
loved ones. Get in touch today to book a suitable time or to find out more.

[otoscopy pic_edited.jpg]
[earimageweb_edited.jpg]

### EAR WAX REMOVAL

Micro suction

Say goodbye to ear wax buildup with my safe and effective micro suction ear wax removal service. I
use gentle micro suction technology to remove excess ear wax quickly and painlessly, ensuring your
ears stay clear and your hearing remains sharp. Book your ear wax removal appointment today.

Home: Services

## ABOUT

Providing Care since 2007

Maria Foley B.A.A.T. M.I.A.A. M.I.S.H.A.A. is  Clinical Audiologist and an independent Hearing Aid
provider with comprehensive experience in Diagnostic Hearing Assessment for adults and paediatrics,
Hearing Aid Fitting, Ear wax removal (micro suction) and Tinnitus Management. 

 

Maria Qualified as an Audiologist in 2007 from The Royal Victoria Hospital, Belfast. Between 2007
and 2023 Maria worked as a Senior Clinical Audiologist in the public sector in the South East of
Ireland. 

 

While working in the public sector, Maria gained extensive experience in Diagnostic Hearing
Assessment & Hearing Aid Fitting in community care and hospital settings.

audiometry, speech audiometry, and tympanometry. Early detection and intervention are key to
managing hearing loss effectively. Schedule your hearing assessment today to ensure optimal hearing
health for you and your family.

comprehensive hearing screenings, including pure-tone audiometry and speech audiometry, to help you

guidelines is also available to protect your hearing health in noisy environments.

solutions.

# Early Hearing Detection & Intervention
# Pediatric Audiology Links to Services

# Welcome to EHDI-PALS

EHDI-PALS is a web-based searchable national directory. It helps families, healthcare professionals,
and state public health organizations to find pediatric audiology expertise for children ages birth
to five. The website provides information about childhood hearing to support families and
professionals through the process of screening, diagnosis, and intervention.

This site links you to information, resources, and services for children with hearing loss. At the
heart of EHDI-PALS is a national web-based directory of facilities that offer pediatric audiology
services to young children who are younger than five years of age.

This website contains great resources for parents and professionals.
[Learn More][10] about childhood hearing loss, hearing testing, early intervention and family
support-including important questions parents may ask as they are going through the EHDI process.

Find [Other Helpful Websites][11], including national and state parent support organizations and
other related resources.

You can also find out more about the [EHDI-PALS Advisory Group][12].

To learn more about childhood hearing loss or if you need help throughout the screening, diagnosis
and early intervention process, [contact your state Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
Coordinator][13] to assist you.

##### Families

## Looking For A Facility?

Find a Facility for hearing services for children from birth to 5 years of age:

[Find Hearing Services][14]

##### Professionals

## List Or Update Your Facility

Are you an audiologist interested in listing your facility in the EHDI-PALS directory? If so, enter
here:

[List or Update Your Facility][15]

## Find a Facility
##  

Are you a professional looking for audiology services for children from birth to five years of age?
If so, enter here:

[Find Hearing Services][16]
Javascript is required for this site to function, please enable it.
[ Contact Us ][17]
[ Link To Us ][18]
[NCHAM] [Utah State University]

EHDI-PALS is supported by the National Center for Hearing Assessment and Management (NCHAM) at Utah
State University with informatics support provided by the University of Maine Developmental
Epidemiology and Biobehavioral Informatics Group. As a research center at Utah State University,
NCHAM is supported by funds from the Utah State Legislature as well as various private, state, and
federal entities. From 2001 - 2024 NCHAM served as the National Technical Resource Center for all
state-based Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) programs in the United States. NCHAM is
committed to promoting respectful dialogue about how to improve services for children who are deaf
or hard of hearing. Materials, presentations, and other activities disseminated by NCHAM represent
many different views and opinions by stakeholders interested in improving services and outcomes for
children who are deaf or hard of hearing. Developers, authors, and presenters of those materials and
activities are responsible for the views and content of their material and no endorsement by NCHAM,
USU, or any of our funders is implied or expressed.

## Compassionate Care

For Your Child’s Unique Needs

# ENT for Children Is Dedicated to Serving Pediatric Patients

Childhood is filled with excitement, and our team strives to make sure our patients can enjoy it to
the fullest. We provide compassionate and comprehensive care for ENT, audiology and allergy concerns
that will guide your youngest family members to a healthy and fulfilling future.

Pediatric patients have unique needs that we are dedicated to meeting. Schedule a consultation with
ENT for Children’s expert and empathetic providers to get started.

[ About Us ][148]
[ Meet Our Team ][149]
[ Request Appointment ][150]

## Pediatric ENT

We provide treatment to make sure ENT symptoms do not detract from the wonders of childhood.

[FIND CARE][151]

## Pediatric Audiology

We are dedicated to ensuring our patients can hear the sounds that make their youth special.

[NURTURE BETTER HEARING][152]

## Pediatric Allergy

Every child has specific allergy triggers, which is why our team customizes care to each patient.

[EXPLORE TREATMENTS][153]

Please call [(972) 745-8400][162] or [(817) 337-3339][163] and follow the instructions to reach the
doctor on call.

## Compassionate Care

For Your Child’s Unique Needs

# ENT for Children Is Dedicated to Serving Pediatric Patients

Childhood is filled with excitement, and our team strives to make sure our patients can enjoy it to
the fullest. We provide compassionate and comprehensive care for ENT, audiology and allergy concerns
that will guide your youngest family members to a healthy and fulfilling future.

Pediatric patients have unique needs that we are dedicated to meeting. Schedule a consultation with
ENT for Children’s expert and empathetic providers to get started.

[ About Us ][148]
[ Meet Our Team ][149]
[ Request Appointment ][150]

## Pediatric ENT

We provide treatment to make sure ENT symptoms do not detract from the wonders of childhood.

[FIND CARE][151]

## Pediatric Audiology

We are dedicated to ensuring our patients can hear the sounds that make their youth special.

[NURTURE BETTER HEARING][152]

## Pediatric Allergy

Every child has specific allergy triggers, which is why our team customizes care to each patient.

[EXPLORE TREATMENTS][153]

## Urgent Matters

To better service our established patients, we have a provider on-call 24 hours a day, 7 days a
week, year round to answer urgent questions. Please be mindful that this service is for problems
that are urgent and that cannot wait till the next business day.

Please call [(972) 745-8400][162] or [(817) 337-3339][163] and follow the instructions to reach the
doctor on call.

## Ear, Nose & Throat Associates

At Ear, Nose and Throat Associates, we strive to bring the highest quality of personalized care to
patients in Northeast Indiana and Northwest Ohio. For more than five decades, our otolaryngologists,
audiologists and nurses have provided expert treatment to ensure you experience the best outcomes.

## Our Featured Services

[

### Ear, Nose & Throat Care

Our customized solutions ensure that uncomfortable ENT solutions don’t detract from your quality of
life.

][183] [

### Audiology

Our team will help you stay engaged with every conversation.

][184] [

### Allergy

We will work with you to identify your allergy triggers and build a personalized treatment plan.

][185]
[

### Aesthetics

Find confidence in your appearance with customized care from our specialists.

][186] [

### Sleep

Get a good night’s rest with our expert and empathetic care from our sleep experts.

][187]

BioInnovation Venture Accelerator

Where biotech companies are launched and products manufactured on the same linearly scalable

Join us in the world we are making where clinical nutrition and medicine are reimagined-advancing
planetary health for current and future generations to come.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][64]

Bioinnovation Venture Accelerator Bridging the translation Gap: Idea to Exit


Esco Aster is a biotech factory helping to spin out our existing Tide Motion bioprocess products
and/or services with the fastest time to clinic, using our standardized, linearly scalable
biomanufacturing platforms that are globally investable and backed by an exit strategy ensuring
returns to all stakeholders — from the public, founders, foundations, and nonprofits to financial
investors.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][65]

cGMP CRDMO


cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and
dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

επιτυχία των ακουολογικών υπηρεσιών. Οι ολοκληρωμένες αξιολογήσεις μας και οι εξατομικευμένες λύσεις
ακοής σας εγγυώνται το καλύτερο δυνατό αποτέλεσμα.
Τα Ακουολογικά Κέντρα Ευθυμιάδης έχουν απλωθεί παγκύπρια για να είναι πιο κοντά σας, παρέχοντας
ολοκληρωμένη ακουστική φροντίδα σε όλο το νησί, με επτά κλινικές σε Λευκωσία, Λατσιά, Έγκωμη,
Λάρνακα, Λεμεσό, Πάφο και Αστρομερίτη καθώς επίσης και κατ’οίκον επισκέψεις σε άτομα με δυσκολία
κίνησης. Κάθε κλινική διατηρεί υψηλά επαγγελματικά πρότυπα και παρέχει τεχνική υποστήριξη και
εξατομικευμένη φροντίδα εφ' όρου ζωής.

## A Few Facts Τα κέντρα μας

Στα Ακουολογικά Κέντρα Ευθυμιάδης, κατανοούμε τη σημασία της άριστης εξυπηρέτησης πελατών για την
επιτυχία των ακουολογικών υπηρεσιών. Οι ολοκληρωμένες αξιολογήσεις μας και οι εξατομικευμένες λύσεις
ακοής σας εγγυώνται το καλύτερο δυνατό αποτέλεσμα.
Τα Ακουολογικά Κέντρα Ευθυμιάδης έχουν απλωθεί παγκύπρια για να είναι πιο κοντά σας, παρέχοντας
ολοκληρωμένη ακουστική φροντίδα σε όλο το νησί, με επτά κλινικές σε Λευκωσία, Λατσιά, Έγκωμη,
Λάρνακα, Λεμεσό, Πάφο και Αστρομερίτη καθώς επίσης και κατ’οίκον επισκέψεις σε άτομα με δυσκολία
κίνησης. Κάθε κλινική διατηρεί υψηλά επαγγελματικά πρότυπα και παρέχει τεχνική υποστήριξη και
εξατομικευμένη φροντίδα εφ' όρου ζωής.

FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator dedicated to co-funding and
co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of
number of startups that we have helped, money invested and money raised. We have supported over 1620
startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

## Overview

At Florida ENT Associates, our experienced specialists are here to help you manage your ear, nose,
and throat health. Look to Florida ENT Associates for care you can count on, expertise you can
trust, and expert providers who put you first.

* [Head & Neck Treatments][207]
* [Voice & Swallowing Treatments][208]
* [Facial Plastic Surgery][209]

[Learn more about our care][210]
[Media image]

## Allergy

Our allergy specialists have decades of experience helping patients of all ages find lasting symptom
relief. From precise allergy testing to cutting-edge immunotherapy treatments that build your
tolerance to your allergen over time, Florida ENT Associates can help you find profound relief from
allergy symptoms.

Related conditions:
* [Environmental Allergy][211]
* [Hives and Eczema][212]

[Learn more about our care][213]
[Media image]

## Sinus

With state-of-the-art technology and cutting-edge treatments, our specialists can diagnose and treat
even the toughest sinus problems. In addition to traditional surgical approaches, we offer minimally
invasive, next-generation solutions for chronic sinus problems so you can find relief with less pain
and downtime.

Related conditions:
* [Sinus Infections][214]
* [Loss of Sense of Taste and Smell][215]
* [Nasal Fractures][216]
* [Deviated Nasal Septum][217]
* [Congestion (Nasal Blockage)][218]
* [Nasal Drainage][219]

[Learn more about our care][220]
[Media image]

## Sleep

Your sleep impacts every area of your life—from your hormones and weight management to memory and
the function of your immune system. If you’re struggling in this area, our sleep specialists can
help you get a good night’s rest again. Whether you’re having trouble falling asleep or you’re
experiencing chronic snoring or daytime fatigue, we can diagnose the underlying problem and help
restore the quality and quantity of your sleep.

Related conditions:
* [Snoring][221]
* [Sleep Apnea][222]

[Learn more about our care][223]
[Media image]

## Audiology

If you’re experiencing hearing loss, Florida ENT Associates' audiology practice is here for you. Our
board-certified audiologists are dedicated to comprehensive hearing care that improves your ability
to communicate. From hearing tests to diagnose the underlying cause of your hearing loss to helping
you select and acclimate to your new hearing aid, we’re by your side every step of the way.

Related conditions:
* [Hearing Loss][224]

[Learn more about our care][225]
[Media image]

## Ear

Florida ENT Associates provides comprehensive pediatric and adult care for every condition related
to the ear—from chronic earaches to complex ear disorders. With your convenience in mind, we perform
the full range of diagnostics in our offices, from hearing exams and balance testing to imaging
tests and diagnostic endoscopies.

Related conditions:
* [Ear Infections][226]
* [Dizziness][227]
* [Complicated Ear Disorders][228]

[Learn more about our care][229]
[Media image]

## Head & Neck

Our board-certified specialists are trained in evaluating, diagnosing, and treating conditions that
affect the head and neck, from tonsillitis to throat tumors. With decades of experience and the
highest level of expertise, you can trust our providers to perform your surgery with the care and
precision necessary to resolve your condition and protect nearby glands and structures (including
the delicate facial nerve).

Related conditions:
* [Thyroid Masses][230]
* [Neck Masses][231]
* [Salivary Glands Masses][232]

Using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools, we assess your auditory system with precision and care. The
process begins with a detailed conversation about your hearing concerns, followed by non-invasive
tests to measure your hearing capabilities. We provide clear explanations of the results and guide
you through your options, whether you need hearing aids, assistive devices, or preventative
measures.

Our evaluations include real-ear measurements to ensure precise hearing aid fittings if needed.
These assessments are not just about diagnosing issues but also about understanding your lifestyle
and how to improve your daily interactions. We focus on your unique needs and deliver
recommendations that enhance your quality of life.

We specialize in pediatric hearing assessments to detect early signs of hearing loss, which is
critical for language development and academic success. Our skilled hearing health professionals use
age-appropriate techniques and tools to achieve accurate results without causing discomfort.

For children diagnosed with hearing challenges, we provide customized solutions, including hearing
aids and assistive devices tailored to their needs. We work closely with families to offer guidance,
education, and support every step of the way. From infancy through adolescence, our goal is to help
children thrive by addressing their hearing needs proactively.

Lenire offers a modern, science-based approach that focuses on how the brain processes tinnitus
rather than simply masking the sound. This treatment is designed to help reduce how noticeable and
disruptive tinnitus becomes over time.

Lenire is intended for adults with the most common form of tinnitus, known as subjective tinnitus.
Treatment begins under the guidance of a trained clinician and is then continued at home, providing
a balance of structure and everyday flexibility.

Tinnitus can disrupt daily life and make it difficult to concentrate or relax. Our approach begins
with a thorough evaluation to determine the underlying causes and contributing factors.

We then develop personalized treatment plans that may include sound therapy, counseling, or advanced
hearing aids with tinnitus-masking features. Managing tinnitus is about alleviating symptoms,
restoring your peace of mind, and helping you regain control. With our compassionate care and proven
strategies, you don’t have to live with the constant noise.

These devices are perfect for enhancing communication in noisy environments, watching television, or
attending public events. We provide expert consultations to match you with the right ALDs for your
needs, whether it’s a personal amplifier, FM system, or TV listening device.

Our team also offers demonstrations and training to ensure you feel confident using your new
technology. ALDs can bridge the gap between traditional hearing aids and the challenges of everyday
listening, empowering you to stay connected and engaged in every aspect of life.

Whether you’re exposed to loud machinery, enjoy hunting or shooting sports, or need earplugs for
concerts or musicianship, we’ve got you covered.

Custom earmolds provide a superior fit for comfort and effectiveness. During your appointment, we
take precise ear impressions to create protection that perfectly suits your ears and lifestyle. With
these tailored solutions, you can protect your hearing without compromising on sound quality or
comfort. Prevention is the first step toward lifelong hearing health.

you through your options, whether you need hearing aids, assistive devices, or preventative
measures.

Our evaluations include real-ear measurements to ensure precise hearing aid fittings if needed.
These assessments are not just about diagnosing issues but also about understanding your lifestyle
and how to improve your daily interactions. We focus on your unique needs and deliver
recommendations that enhance your quality of life.

We specialize in pediatric hearing assessments to detect early signs of hearing loss, which is
critical for language development and academic success. Our skilled hearing health professionals use
age-appropriate techniques and tools to achieve accurate results without causing discomfort.

For children diagnosed with hearing challenges, we provide customized solutions, including hearing
aids and assistive devices tailored to their needs. We work closely with families to offer guidance,
education, and support every step of the way. From infancy through adolescence, our goal is to help
children thrive by addressing their hearing needs proactively.

Lenire offers a modern, science-based approach that focuses on how the brain processes tinnitus
rather than simply masking the sound. This treatment is designed to help reduce how noticeable and
disruptive tinnitus becomes over time.

Lenire is intended for adults with the most common form of tinnitus, known as subjective tinnitus.
Treatment begins under the guidance of a trained clinician and is then continued at home, providing
a balance of structure and everyday flexibility.

Tinnitus can disrupt daily life and make it difficult to concentrate or relax. Our approach begins
with a thorough evaluation to determine the underlying causes and contributing factors.

We then develop personalized treatment plans that may include sound therapy, counseling, or advanced
hearing aids with tinnitus-masking features. Managing tinnitus is about alleviating symptoms,
restoring your peace of mind, and helping you regain control. With our compassionate care and proven
strategies, you don’t have to live with the constant noise.

These devices are perfect for enhancing communication in noisy environments, watching television, or
attending public events. We provide expert consultations to match you with the right ALDs for your
needs, whether it’s a personal amplifier, FM system, or TV listening device.

Our team also offers demonstrations and training to ensure you feel confident using your new
technology. ALDs can bridge the gap between traditional hearing aids and the challenges of everyday
listening, empowering you to stay connected and engaged in every aspect of life.

Whether you’re exposed to loud machinery, enjoy hunting or shooting sports, or need earplugs for
concerts or musicianship, we’ve got you covered.

Custom earmolds provide a superior fit for comfort and effectiveness. During your appointment, we
take precise ear impressions to create protection that perfectly suits your ears and lifestyle. With
these tailored solutions, you can protect your hearing without compromising on sound quality or
comfort. Prevention is the first step toward lifelong hearing health.

[Get In Touch ][93] [Online Hearing Test][94]

## As featured in

## Hearing care services

At Harley Street Hearing, we specialise in all aspects of hearing to enhance your communication in
everyday life. We provide hearing diagnosis, solutions for your individual hearing needs, as well as
luxury custom-made protection for all types of lifestyle choices.

As part of Harley Street Hearing, Musicians’ Hearing Services provides hearing protection and advice
to the UK entertainment industry. Our team of highly qualified clinical audiologists specialise in
all areas of hearing care, from hearing tests and ear wax removal to custom-made hearing protection,
tinnitus therapy and more.

With over 25 years’ experience serving clients from the Royal Opera House to well-known artists and
bands, our team understands the unique demands of these professions. In partnership with Help
Musicians, the Musicians’ Union (MU), and The Independent Society of Musicians (ISM), we provide
affordable access to the [Musicians’ Hearing Health Scheme][95] for musicians across the UK.

[view all Services][96][get in touch ][97]
Hearing consultations
We offer professional, thorough hearing tests to effectively diagnose any hearing loss.

Dedicated to delivering outstanding service and treating all of our patients with the utmost care
and understanding, our hearing consultation pays particular attention to your individual hearing
needs.
[Learn more][98]
Hearing aids
As an independent audiology clinic, we can offer an extensive range of hearing aids from all major
worldwide manufacturers and aren't affiliated with any one company.

Our clinical audiologists will work with you to find you the best technology that suits your
individual hearing needs, lifestyle and budget.
[Learn more][99]
Hearing protection
We offer custom-fit hearing protection to suit your requirements, designed to help maintain your ear
and hearing health and reduce the risk of noise-induced hearing loss.

Musicians' Hearing Services is a part of the Harley Street Hearing Group and has been serving the
entertainment industry for over 25 years, offering custom-made hearing protection.
[Learn more][100]

everyday life. We provide hearing diagnosis, solutions for your individual hearing needs, as well as
luxury custom-made protection for all types of lifestyle choices.

[Learn more][100]
Ear wax removal
We offer safe and effective ear wax removal, performed by highly skilled clinical audiologists who
specialise in microsuction and irrigation.

We can typically cater for same-day appointments at any of our clinics across London.
[Learn more][101]
Tinnitus therapy
We help patients overcome and alleviate the symptoms caused by tinnitus, through accurate diagnoses
and effective tinnitus retraining therapy.

Our tinnitus assessment packages are effective at diagnosing your individual struggles and devising
a suitable treatment plan.
[Learn more][102]
Auditory processing disorder testing
We offer professional testing and treatments for auditory processing disorder, using various
treatment tools to help patients manage the condition.
[Learn more][103]
Vestibular testing and rehabilitation
We offer a comprehensive audio vestibular (balance) diagnostic service at our Balance Centre at 127
Harley Street.
[Learn more][104]
Musicians' Hearing Services
We provide a range of tailor-made services to entertainment industry personnel, including advice on
hearing protection, on-site noise assessments, and specialist technology for those affected by
hearing loss.
[Learn more][105]

## London’s leading private hearing clinic

We have been established on Harley Street for over 25 years. At our Harley Street Hearing clinics,
we know that customer care is fundamental to a successful independent audiology clinic.

As hearing aid specialists we understand that having hearing loss can be isolating and difficult to
accept, and so we treat all our patients with care and understanding.

[book an appointment][109]
[http://127%20harley%20st%20hearing%20clinic]

## Audiology provider for London hospitals

Harley Street Hearing takes immense pride in offering premier audiology services, from our highly
trained clinical audiologists, to esteemed hospitals and clinics across London.

We are honoured to be the providers to renowned ENT consultants within the HCA Healthcare UK London
Hospitals as well as the Phoenix Hospital Group.

Our dedicated team provides on-demand clinics tailored specifically for ENT Consultants, ensuring
their patients have instant access to high-quality audiology care.

[Our locations][110]
[http://9%20Harley%20Street%20phoenix%20hospital%20group]

## 25+ years serving the entertainment industry

We are also Musicians’ Hearing Services, a trusted name within the entertainment world, supporting
the unique hearing needs of performers, musicians, and industry professionals.

Our team works hand-in-hand with the Musicians’ Union and the British Association for Performing
Arts Medicine, ensuring specialist care that truly understands the demands of a life in music.

We’re also proud partners in delivering the **[Musicians’ Hearing Health Scheme][111]**, helping to
protect the hearing of those who make their living through sound.

[Musicians' Hearing Services][112]
[http://coldplay%20banner]

### The Hearing Guy at Hearing Tracker

Our expert team receives daily questions about hearing aids and the latest advancements in hearing
technology.

Matthew Allsop, clinical audiologist and partner, shares his insights to help answer some of the
most common queries—whether from patients in our clinic or people curious at home, on Hearing
Tracker – the world’s first truly independent shopping resource for hearing aid users.

Matthew is now the most-followed hearing technology YouTuber in Europe, with over 82,000
subscribers. He offers trusted advice on all aspects of hearing health, including in-depth reviews
of current and upcoming hearing technology from leading global brands such as Oticon, Phonak,
ReSound, Signia, Starkey, Widex, and more.

[find out more][113]
[banner_image][mobile banner]
[background-image]

## Visiting our specialist London hearing clinic

We are the largest and longest-serving private hearing clinic in London, located on Harley Street.
We are an independent diagnostic audiology centre, so come to us for all your hearing needs. From
ear wax removal (appointments are normally available within 24 hours) and hearing tests to providing
cutting-edge hearing aids.

Our highly qualified clinical audiologists and front-of-house team are on hand to provide the
highest standards of care, in a friendly, relaxed and professional environment. We are a
[Multilingual Hearing Clinic][114] with our expert clinical audiologists able to provide seamless,
personalised support and overcoming language barriers for many of our international patients.

As a fully independent practice, we have a complete portfolio of hearing aids and are not tied to
one manufacturer like many of the high-street providers. At our Harley Street Hearing clinics, at 2
Harley Street and 127 Harley Street, our hearing aid specialists ensure all hearing technology will
be personalised to each client’s audiological profile and lifestyle needs. If you’re looking for
independent London audiologists we are here for all your hearing needs.

### Ask Us Anything

Could working with AZ Hearing expand my business?
Yes, we always try to help our partners gain a bigger market share. Our Puro helped a few
distributors in the States achieve a huge breakthrough in e-commerce, allowing them to sell 5000
units a month. AZ Hearing does not just supply hearing aid products, we are ready and willing to
discuss business solutions with you.
Should I consider purchasing hearing aids from AZ Hearing?

Definitely. There are numbers of hearing aid suppliers in China, we may not be the best, but we’re
certainly trustworthy.
AZ Hearing is a professional manufacturers and factory of hearing aids, sound amplifiers and
faceplate in China, we have over 6 years of OEM/ODM experience.
As a medical device, hearing aid is closely related to the user’s health and life, and quality is
especially important. Quality is a key part enriches us with confidence. We share information and do
business with our partners openly and honestly. 

What are the modes of transport?

Hearing aids are relatively small in size, light in weight and high in added value, and express
delivery is the preferred method for most buyers, with express carriers including DHL, UPS, FedEx,
TNT and others. The shipping fee for the sample is around $35$-60$ based on global zones for your
reference.
If you have set up your own express account, we could ship with your account if you wish. 

What is the future of hearing aid industry?

Good question, thank you for asking it. Hearing aid manufacturing in China has developed rapidly in
the last decade or so. The market need for hearing aids is increasing with population ageing and
awareness of hearing care. From the demand side, hearing aids market is thriving.

Hearing aid technology is also evolving, for instance, the application of Bluetooth, apps and
rechargeability. We think hearing aids will become an increasingly important wearable device that
can assist users during daily life.

The involvement of tech companies like Bose, Nuhera & Eargo in recent years indicates that more and
more companies are bullish on hearing aid market.

We’re looking forward to more changes in hearing aids market and will continue to offer
cost-effective hearing aids for our partners. 

How do you ensure the quality of the product?

First of all, our factory follows ISO regulations and has a strict quality inspection process to
ensure quality. IQC is performed after raw materials are obtained, FQC is performed when production
is completed, and OQC is performed after packaging.

We also implement the CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) system to improve quality. If there
are any problems occur during the production, the process will be suspended and we will provide
feedback on the problem. Preventive actions will also be taken to stop similar problems happen in
the future. 

How does AZ Hearing provide maintenance services?

If you could repair locally, we can send components to you; or you can send defective hearing aids
back to China so we could repair/refurbish them. China Customs has strict requirements and
procedures for importing used electronics, but don’t worry, we are able to follow up to ensure a
smooth process. 

How to sell with our brand, and customize the product?
We have an ODM service, you can make your request and we will work on design and production. If you
want to sell with your own brand, we can offer a complete labeling solution, from hearing aid
lettering to packaging. For more info, you could visit our OEM/ODM page.
What is the difference between distribution of hearing aid and sound amplifier?

In short, hearing aids are medical devices, sound amplifiers are electronics. Whether they are sound
amplifiers or hearing aids depends on how different markets define each type. In some European
countries, if the gain exceeds 25dB could be a boundary. In other countries, hearing aids mean that
programmable while sound amplifiers can be digital but not programmable.
